title: Canonical structure-sheaf comparisons commute with maps of squares
statement: Let $p:X\to Y$, $q:A\to B$, $t:C\to D$, $g:B\to Y$, $h:D\to Y$, $k:A\to X$ and $l:C\to X$ be scheme maps [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] satisfying $k;p=q;g$ and $l;p=t;h$. Let $v:D\to B$ and $w:C\to A$ satisfy $v;g=h$, $w;k=l$, and $w;q=t;v$. Let $b:g^*p_*\mathcal O_X\to q_*\mathcal O_A$ and $b^{\prime}:h^*p_*\mathcal O_X\to t_*\mathcal O_C$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] equal the canonical adjoints of restriction along $k$ and $l$, transported through the pushforward composition comparisons. Write $T$ for the section transport [def-sbc-pullback-section-factorization]. For every $x\in\Gamma(g^*p_*\mathcal O_X)$ and $a\in\Gamma(A,\mathcal O_A)$ with $b(x)=a$, one has $b^{\prime}(Tx)=w^\sharp(a)$. No cartesianness or invertibility is assumed.

source.place: Tag 02KG, canonical affine tensor comparison; Tag 01CA, tensor functoriality and associativity.

proof.text: Unfold the constructed pullbackSectionFactorization section map as the adjunction unit followed by the composition comparison.
Substitute the specified defining equalities of b and b′. Apply the adjunction homEquiv to the corresponding sheaf identity, and use naturality of its units and the pullback composition comparison.
The two adjoints are restrictions from O_X to O_C. Use w;k=l and w;q=t;v, and coherence of pushforward composition comparisons, to identify them.

Injectivity of homEquiv gives the sheaf identity. Evaluation at the top open gives the displayed formula with pullbackΓ and w.appTop. Replace b(x) by the prescribed section a using the image equality.

theorem structure_baseChange_sections_naturality
    {X Y A B C D : Scheme.{u}}
    (p : X ⟶ Y) (q : A ⟶ B) (t : C ⟶ D)
    (g : B ⟶ Y) (h : D ⟶ Y) (k : A ⟶ X) (l : C ⟶ X)
    (sq : k ≫ p = q ≫ g) (sq' : l ≫ p = t ≫ h)
    (v : D ⟶ B) (w : C ⟶ A)
    (vg : v ≫ g = h) (wk : w ≫ k = l) (wq : w ≫ q = t ≫ v)
    (b : (pullback g).obj ((pushforward p).obj (unit X)) ⟶
      (pushforward q).obj (unit A))
    (b' : (pullback h).obj ((pushforward p).obj (unit X)) ⟶
      (pushforward t).obj (unit C))
    (hb : b = ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).homEquiv _ _).symm
      ((pushforward p).map (unitToPushforwardObjUnit k.toRingCatSheafHom) ≫
        (pushforwardComp k p).hom.app (unit A) ≫
        (pushforwardCongr sq).hom.app (unit A) ≫
        (pushforwardComp q g).inv.app (unit A)))
    (hb' : b' = ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction h).homEquiv _ _).symm
      ((pushforward p).map (unitToPushforwardObjUnit l.toRingCatSheafHom) ≫
        (pushforwardComp l p).hom.app (unit C) ≫
        (pushforwardCongr sq').hom.app (unit C) ≫
        (pushforwardComp t h).inv.app (unit C)))
    (x : Γ((pullback g).obj ((pushforward p).obj (unit X)), ⊤))
    (a : Γ(A, ⊤)) (hx : Hom.app b ⊤ x = a) :
    Hom.app b' ⊤ (pullbackSectionFactorization g h v vg ((pushforward p).obj (unit X)) x) =
      w.appTop a
